-- BuilderKit server entry point
-- Require BuilderKit from ReplicatedStorage and start building.

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local BuilderKit = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("BuilderKit"))

-- Example: build a simple platform on startup
BuilderKit.execute({
    type = "createPart",
    params = {
        name = "SpawnPlatform",
        position = { x = 0, y = 5, z = 0 },
        size = { x = 16, y = 1, z = 16 },
        material = "SmoothPlastic",
        color = "#4A90D9"
    }
})

print("[BuilderKit] Server initialized — SpawnPlatform created")
